nodes.label: Fingerprint Attendance API (HF-X05)
nodes.rationale: Adapts the original Firebase Callable Function contract to this app's actual stack: plain Next.js API routes over the same Firestore database as the web app, multi-tenant across altavision.lk and carecode.org.

nodes.label: Device Auth: Shared Secret + Registered Device
nodes.rationale: Replaces Firebase Auth device identity with FINGERPRINT_API_KEY plus a per-device Firestore doc that must be active:true; there is no self-registration, so a terminal is provisioned once by an admin.

nodes.label: userId = epf_number Identity Mapping
nodes.rationale: No opaque Firestore auto-id exists here - epf_number is the id used everywhere (attendances, tasks, leaves) and is also the users doc id. employeeId maps to employee_number when present, otherwise falls back to epf_number.

nodes.label: Scans Write Into the Same attendances sessions[]
nodes.rationale: Rather than a standalone attendanceEvents ledger, a scan lands in the same attendances/{epf}_{date}.sessions[] array the mobile check-in/out flow uses, so it shows up immediately in every existing report and export with no reconciliation step.

nodes.label: Fingerprint Sessions Are Auto-Approved
nodes.rationale: A fingerprint match already proves identity plus physical presence, so no supervisor approval step is inserted; *_approved_by is the sentinel 'FINGERPRINT' rather than a real epf.

nodes.label: Food-Allowance Flag Computation
nodes.rationale: Computed the same way the Approvals page does (before 06:45 cat 1, 06:45-07:00 cat 2 on check-in, after 19:00 cat 1 on check-out) using Asia/Colombo local time regardless of the server's own timezone.

nodes.label: Shift-Worker Yesterday Look-Back on Check-Out
nodes.rationale: If a user is is_shift_worker and has no open session today, a check-out scan checks yesterday's attendance doc for an open session before opening a new one - the same convention the working-status feed uses.

nodes.label: POST /api/fingerprint/sync-users
nodes.rationale: Deactivated users are deliberately included so the terminal can disable them locally; nothing is filtered out by `active`. Cursor is nextUpdatedAfter, persisted and passed back as updatedAfter.

nodes.label: POST/GET /api/fingerprint/enrollments
nodes.rationale: Only enrollment/template metadata is stored - templateDataBase64 for fingerprints is rejected outright (FPA-103) and the endpoint never returns template bytes, so template backup mode from the original contract is not implemented.

nodes.label: Face-Template Backup Extension (SFace)
nodes.rationale: Omitting biometricType still means FINGERPRINT, preserving the metadata-only five-slot contract for existing clients. FACE accepts only portable SFace feature bytes in three slots - never images, thumbnails or Android-Keystore ciphertext - and is deterministic per employee/device so a new enrollment replaces its slots rather than appending.

nodes.label: Server-Side Action Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: When `action` is omitted the backend infers direction from session state. An explicit CHECK_IN over an open session closes it at this punch's raw timestamp (never truncated to a scheduled time), flags both sessions and raises a review row. A CHECK_OUT with no open session is REJECTED so no phantom session is ever created; the event is logged but not locked in so a retry can still succeed.

nodes.label: 45-Second Punch Debounce
nodes.rationale: Backed by fingerprint_last_punch/{epf_number}, an Admin-SDK-only global duplicate-punch guard.

nodes.label: fingerprint_attendance_events Idempotency Lock
nodes.rationale: The ledger exists only as the idempotency lock keyed by attendanceEventId - it is not a reporting surface. A REJECTED event is deliberately not locked in so the same id can be retried after the underlying problem is fixed.

nodes.label: POST /api/fingerprint/attendance/bulk
nodes.rationale: Offline queue flush always responds 200 with one result per event so a bad event never fails the batch. Events are processed in deviceTimestamp order rather than array order or in parallel, so one person's scans toggle check-in/check-out correctly.

nodes.label: Admin Device Provisioning Endpoints
nodes.rationale: There is no DELETE - a compromised or decommissioned unit is disabled with PATCH { active: false } so its enrollment and attendance history is kept. workingPlace is the fixed location recorded on every punch because terminals have no GPS, unlike the mobile app.

nodes.label: Fingerprint Firestore Collection Layout
nodes.rationale: attendance_devices, fingerprint_enrollments, fingerprint_attendance_events and fingerprint_last_punch are Admin-SDK-only and denied outright to browsers; attendance_reviews and recalc_queue are readable and transitionable by the web app, and attendance_segments is read-only there.

nodes.label: attendance_reviews Queue (flagged/in_review/resolved)
nodes.rationale: Anything implausible - a reconciled double check-in, a session running 20h or more - is parked for a supervisor rather than silently corrected, and closed pending rather than auto-approved.

nodes.label: attendance_segments and recalc_queue
nodes.rationale: Retro-recalculation derives a scheduled vs ot_unverified split into attendance_segments; a roster back-date enqueues recalc_queue work to re-derive those segments.
